title: Aaron's Archery Appendages.
html:
Aaron's Archery Appendages
Aaron's Archery Appendages.
Released21 January 2004 (Update)
MembersYes
LocationRanging Guild
League region Kandarin✓
OwnerArmour salesman
SpecialtyRanged armour
Location

Aaron's Archery Appendages is a shop where Aaron the Armour salesman sells low level ranged armour. Aaron also sells the Ranged Cape of Accomplishment. His shop is located in the Ranging Guild, so it can only be accessed by players with at least level 40 Ranged.

Ranging cape

[edit | edit source]

If a player has 99 Ranged, they will have access to a duplicate version of the shop, with the only difference being the addition of the Ranging cape. The stock of this shop is not shared with the regular shop.
